name: bellwether
description: Explore conference papers and their source-backed dataset links from VS Code.

bellwether.installPath.description: Bellwether checkout or install directory. Leave empty to use the current workspace when ready, then ~/.bellwether.

bellwether.pythonPath.description: Python 3.10+ executable. Leave empty to use the install's serving venv, then python3 (python on Windows).

bellwether.extraPath.description: Optional executable directory for the Codex or Claude CLI when VS Code's extension host cannot find it.

bellwether.useMeilisearch.description: Start the installed Meilisearch engine when available.
